Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Individual student reflection submission structured per part (Bagian 1, 2, 3, and Refleksi Akhir Diri).

nama.description: Full name entered by the student.

kelas.description: Student class code across grades 7, 8, and 9.

accessCode.description: School activity access passcode verified at submission.

answers.description: Map of question IDs (A1..R5) to student responses.

completedParts.description: List of completed reflection part IDs.

skorPg.description: Number of correct multiple-choice answers out of 35.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when submission was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when submission was last updated.

DriveSyncSettings.title: DriveSyncSettings
DriveSyncSettings.description: Teacher Google Drive folder and Google Spreadsheet sync metadata.

folderId.description: Google Drive folder ID where reflection backups and spreadsheet are stored.

folderName.description: Human-readable name of the Google Drive folder.

spreadsheetId.description: Google Spreadsheet ID for synced reflection responses.

spreadsheetUrl.description: Direct URL to open the synced Google Spreadsheet.

lastSyncedCount.description: Number of submissions included in the last sync.

updatedBy.description: Admin UID that performed the last sync.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last sync.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin record was created.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores each student's structured reflection progress and answers.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores Google Drive and Google Sheets sync targets for the teacher.
